{"id":2062053554,"question_id":72,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week, 6 days","timestamp":1783618654,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"76 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2062053554/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Edit Distance","memory":"83.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic: \n    vector<vector<int>>dp;\n\n    int byrec(string word1 , string word2 , int i , int j)\n    {\n        //base case \n        if(i >= word1.size()) return word2.size() - j;\n        if(j >= word2.size()) return word1.size() - i;\n        if(dp[i][j] != -1) return dp[i][j];\n\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        if(word1[i] == word2[j]) \n        {\n            int matched = 0 + byrec(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n            ans = min(ans , matched);\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            int replacement = 1 + byrec(word1, word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n            int deletion = 1 + byrec(word1, word2 , i , j+1);\n            int insertion = 1 + byrec(word1, word2 , i+1 , j);\n            ans = min({ans , replacement , deletion , insertion});\n        }\n\n        return dp[i][j] = ans;\n    }\n\n    int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {\n        int n = word1.size();\n        int m = word2.size();\n\n        dp.assign(n+1 , vector<int>(m+1 , -1));\n        return byrec(word1 , word2 , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"edit-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2310}
